cover.learning_purpose: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance.
cover.title: DA08 · Data Visualization · cover
cover.caption: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance. Choose a chart that supports a specific comparison honestly.
cover.alt_text: A straightedge aligns two symbolic columns to a shared baseline, emphasizing honest comparison rather than exaggerated differences.
cover.extended_description:
Choose a chart that supports a specific comparison honestly.

A bar chart starting its axis near the smallest value exaggerates a small completion-rate difference. Use an appropriate baseline and show the rates and cohort sizes explicitly.

Dramatic appearance is not accuracy. Explain the baseline and retain rates, cohort sizes and uncertainty.
cover.generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. BTG AI educational lesson cover, high-resolution 16:9. One dominant editorial visual metaphor, one subtle secondary context element, no explanatory diagram. Sophisticated matte cut-paper illustration, indigo #141724 background, restrained cyan and violet, quiet warm neutrals, tactile paper, soft subtle depth. Essential subject grouped within the central 40% of the frame for square and 4:5 crops, generous empty border and title-safe upper margin. No text, letters, numerals, chart values, logos, robots, brains, neon or fictitious dashboards. Lesson Data Visualization: choose honest visual comparison. Canonical example: truncated bar-chart baseline can exaggerate a small completion-rate difference; preserve appropriate baseline, rate labels and cohort sizes in real analysis. Dominant metaphor: a drafting straightedge leveling the base of two abstract paper columns, with an offset loose baseline strip beside it. Secondary element: a blank data sheet. This is a symbolic editorial motif, not an actual data chart: no ticks, quantities, axes labels or implied measured outcomes. Emphasize fair comparison and scale.
